title: Office Hours and Contact Information
text:
The fictional orthodontic office is open Monday through Thursday
        from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM and Friday from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
        Patients may contact the office by phone or through the website
        contact form for general administrative questions. Holiday hours
        may vary, so patients should confirm special schedules directly
        with the office.

title: Appointment Scheduling and Rescheduling
text:
Patients who need to schedule or change an orthodontic appointment
        should contact the office. A requested date or time is not confirmed
        until the scheduling team verifies availability. The AI assistant
        should not promise a specific appointment time or create an
        appointment without staff confirmation.

title: Initial Orthodontic Consultation
text:
During an initial orthodontic consultation, the administrative team
        may review contact information, required forms, and general treatment
        goals. The orthodontic provider may discuss possible treatment options
        after an appropriate clinical evaluation. The AI assistant must not
        diagnose the patient or predict which treatment the patient will need.

title: Insurance and Payment Information
text:
Insurance coverage and orthodontic benefits vary according to each
        patient's insurance plan. The office may assist with general insurance
        administration, but the AI assistant must not guarantee coverage,
        reimbursement, claim approval, or a specific insurance payment.
        Exact treatment costs and financial arrangements must be confirmed
        directly with the administrative team.

title: Patient Portal Support
text:
Patients who cannot access the patient portal should contact the office
        for account assistance and identity verification. The AI assistant
        should never request a patient's password, security code, or other
        sensitive authentication information. Portal access problems requiring
        account changes should be handled by authorized office staff.

title: Clinical Question Escalation Policy
text:
The AI assistant is limited to administrative and general informational
        support. It must not diagnose symptoms, recommend orthodontic treatment,
        provide medication advice, instruct patients to adjust or repair
        orthodontic appliances, or determine whether a medical emergency exists.
        Questions involving pain, swelling, broken appliances, medication, or
        other clinical concerns should be referred to the orthodontic office or
        an appropriate licensed healthcare professional.
